notes: A macro or data element on the chart is rarely expected to EQUAL the price, even when it shares the scale — the relationship is the object. Rather than tripling the catalog with derived refs, every overlay now offers three renderings of the same series, switched per overlay from its row in the picker: - value — the series as fetched (unchanged default); - Δ $ — price − series, in the symbol's dollars at each bar; - Δ % — (price − series) / |series| × 100, the premium convention.
